sections.what_happened: Russia fired 16 ballistic missiles at Kyiv/Kyiv region + 200+ drones nationwide overnight; 10+ energy facilities damaged; 550,000+ families without power/heat/water; Zelenskyy says partners gave no early warning (again), accuses US of slowing Starshield, limiting intel sharing, delaying PURL-funded Patriot packages (one awaiting Hegseth signature); Trump says 'somebody else should negotiate' for Ukraine, defends Russia, open to Putin-Xi trilateral on Ukraine/denuclearization in China in November; Kushner+Witkoff to Norway this week for Ukraine-Russia talks, Zelensky expected (tentative)
sections.what_verified: Multiple backbone outlets (AP, Reuters, Japan Times, Korea Times, The Hindu) carry Zelenskyy's figures; Russia MoD confirms a 'massive strike' occurred (targets disputed); Ukraine air force spokesman Ihnat confirms warning gap pattern
sections.what_disputed: Trump: Washington has not stopped intel sharing; Rubio: no information on the night's attack; Russia says it hit military-industrial targets (data centre, drone-component logistics, locomotive depot), not a civilian grid campaign; US denies deliberate restriction
sections.why_matters: Zelenskyy blames Washington for no warning as Trump shops a trilateral without Kyiv: the war's paymaster is renegotiating Ukraine's future over its head while Russia degrades the grid before winter. Treat Russian MoD target claims and Zelenskyy betrayal claims as competing primary-source claims, label both on screen.
